limits: The rows are derived from 860 finite representatives selected by the prior M31/M21-M30 membership package.
The Lean source proves the general lift identity and contains one kernel-checked all-k descent declaration per listed row; this does not prove Collatz convergence.
The source family rows used for overlap remain arithmetic-screen evidence; this package does not convert those unrelated screens to Lean proofs.
No novelty or density claim is made.
method: Each row uses the Lean-proved power-of-two lift identity plus exact finite endpoint, odd-count and slope-margin arithmetic.
